description: This Java class defines a singleton validator for boolean header values in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It parses CharSequence inputs to boolean types, throwing an exception if parsing fails.

classes.name: BooleanValueValidator
classes.description: Validator for boolean header values, ensuring that input strings represent valid boolean literals ('true' or 'false').

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the BooleanValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates that the given CharSequence value represents a boolean ('true' or 'false'), throws an exception if invalid.
